services.name: Classes at Englewood Arts
services.desc: Swap dinner and drinks for clay and creativity. Ceramic Date Night invites pairs to unwind and create using wheel throwing ceramic techniques in a casual, welcoming studio environment. Whether you’re making mugs, small vessels, or sculptural pieces, this class is about process over perfection and enjoying the experience together. Bonus: Beverages included! Looking for a creative date idea? How about making glass and a memory you both won’t soon forget? Englewood Arts offers this unique experience with wine and dessert included.
